title: Natural browser conversation
goal: Enable Browse through visible TALOS controls, inspect a controlled page, capture owned screenshot evidence, interact with one visible control and preserve context after reload.
user_facts: The user knows the controlled target URL but no internal tool name.
The user expects screenshot evidence to appear inside the conversation.

checkpoints.description: Browse is enabled from a visible control.
required_visible_outcomes: The composer visibly reports Browse as active.

checkpoints.description: A real worker screenshot is rendered in the assistant response.
required_visible_outcomes: The screenshot has a visible preview and an owned artifact reference.

checkpoints.description: The visible conversation and browser mode survive reload.
required_visible_outcomes: Prior turns and Browse state remain visible after reload.

forbidden_outcomes.description: The assistant must not claim a screenshot without an owned artifact.
No raw validator, SQL or worker exception is shown to the user.

graders.expected_outcome: Natural follow-ups retain the visible conversation context.
Every screenshot claim resolves to a visible owner-scoped artifact.
Conversation and Browse state persist through reload.
